versions.changelog: Initial release. Bilingual (zh/en) static company marketing site workflow — Astro 6 + React 19 islands (mobile menu only) + Tailwind 4 build, Volcengine TOS + CDN + HTTPS hardening deploy via 5 idempotent Node scripts. Includes a SigV4 signer (volc-api.mjs) as escape hatch for CDN actions not in ve CLI 1.0.x. Ships landmines.md catalog of known gotchas (HTTPS_PROXY pollution, TOS SDK quirks, CDN vs DCDN verification, pnpm-deploy collision, free DV cert console-only). Skill explicitly self-deflects to GitHub Pages or Vercel for personal sites / international-only audiences that don't need mainland-China optimization or ICP filing.
